articleBlocks: At first, this puzzle felt like it was pointing towards general concepts of direction or guidance.
The compass rose and one-way street signs seemed to confirm that initial read.
But what about archery classes and assembly diagrams? They felt off.
That theory broke down pretty quickly.
The 'Bottom right of your keyboard' clue was the turning point for me.
It forced me to rethink the other clues more literally, ditching the abstract.
Each clue does contain a real arrow, in a very concrete way.
The answer is 'Places to find arrows'.

Sometimes the most direct reading is the correct one, if you can see it.
The trick is not to overthink the clues and look for simple connections.
